content_fixes.old: God does NOT play. Seriously, don't mess with Him. He gets back at His haters and stands up to anyone who comes against Him, full force. But, like, He's not just flying off the handle. He's got insane power, but He's patient with it. Still, nobody gets away with anything. Sooner or later, you gotta pay up. You see tornadoes and hurricanes? That's just the dust kicking up where He walks. He can literally tell the ocean to dry up, and it does. All the rivers? Gone. The mountains of Bashan and Carmel? Total glow-down. The forests of Lebanon? Wilted. Mountains are shook, hills basically melt. The whole planet is freaking out in front of Him. The whole world is in a full-blown panic. Who could even handle that kind of anger? Who can stand up to that fire? His rage is like a volcano erupting, and He smashes boulders like nothing.
